en.headline: Businesses across {land} that are hard to find online (your next clients)
en.subheadline: Every Monday, {firma} would receive local businesses across {land} with no website, an outdated site or security gaps, each with phone, email and a short sales briefing for marketing agencies.

signals.title: No website
signals.text: Reachable by phone and email, but no website of their own. Your pitch: a Google profile, local SEO and a first campaign.

signals.title: Outdated or not mobile
signals.text: An old site or one that fails on phones. Your pitch: visibility that brings enquiries, not just traffic.

signals.title: Security gaps
signals.text: Browsers warn visitors away. Your pitch: fix trust first, then ads and SEO that convert.

faq.a: Local businesses from across {land} with no website, an outdated or non-mobile site or security gaps. Each lead goes to only one firm.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: From public business sources and the companies' own websites, which we check and combine ourselves. We do not use LinkedIn, Google Maps or other platforms whose terms forbid it.

faq.q: Is there personal data in the leads?
faq.a: Only what the business publishes: company name, address, phone and email, plus the owner's name where public sources list it.

faq.q: How does this fit a marketing or SEO agency?
faq.a: Every lead is a business that is hard to find or hard to trust online, so {firma} calls with a concrete reason: local SEO, a Google profile, ads or social media.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from across {land}, with the same fields as the weekly delivery: a PDF briefing and a spreadsheet.
Yes. The sample is free and without obligation: no card, no subscription. It gives you a first impression of the leads and how well they fit {firma}.
